references.text: Pi-Hahiroth is mentioned as the place where the Israelites camped before crossing the sea
Describes the Israelites' crossing of the sea on dry ground
Tells of the three-day journey through the Wilderness of Shur and arrival at Marah
The Wilderness of Etham is near this route through the wilderness
Previous verse mentioning the departure from Etham and camping at Pi-Hahiroth
Poetic description of God's threat against the Sea of Reeds and leading them through the deep as through a wilderness
Refers to God who led the people through the deep without stumbling
Paul refers to the fathers' crossing of the sea and their baptism in the cloud and the sea
By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land
